name: Kog'Maw
notes: Icathian Surprise (P) only matters if Kog'Maw dies, which never happens against a stationary dummy that never fights back, so it contributes nothing and is left out of the kit.

Living Artillery (R) is cast the instant it is off cooldown for the whole fight, starting at t=0 (the engine's opening ult cast); its 0.25 s cast time keeps Kog'Maw busy (no other cast, no attack) until it ends, and its 0.6 s travel delay to impact is modeled as a separate later event, with the missing-health damage bonus computed off the dummy's health at the moment the globule lands, not at cast.

Reading 'instead' literally for Living Artillery: below 40% max health the flat double (2.0x) replaces the missing-health ramp rather than stacking with it; at or above 40% health the ramp (0.8333% bonus per 1% missing health, capped at 50% at 60% missing) applies.

Bio-Arcane Barrage (W) is recast the instant it is off cooldown (cooldown starts on cast); it has no cast time and no cast damage of its own (an instant toggle), only the on-hit magic damage rider on attacks landed while its 8 s window is active. Its damage cap against minions/monsters is not modeled since the dummy is a champion-type target.

Caustic Spittle (Q) is cast on cooldown (its own attack-speed passive is applied continuously once ranked); its 'basic attack timer' cast time is treated as costing no time of its own (it rides the attack timer rather than blocking casts), unlike Void Ooze and Living Artillery which have a real 0.25 s cast time that keeps Kog'Maw busy. Its armor/magic resistance shred is applied via the shred slot on every cast, using the rank-5 value (32%) since the engine reads a single shred percentage from the kit rather than one per rank; this slightly overstates the shred at low levels/ranks (e.g. level 1).

Void Ooze (E) is cast on cooldown for its upfront magic damage, and its 0.25 s cast time keeps Kog'Maw busy (no other cast, no attack) until it ends; the ooze trail it leaves behind only slows (no source states it deals further damage), so no repeat damage is modeled from it.

Mana is not modeled: the champion's base mana pool is not in the provided numbers sheet, so Living Artillery's ramping mana surcharge (up to +360 over 9 stacks) cannot be checked against it; casts are assumed unconstrained for the fight length simulated here.
